answer: A concrete approach: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. An identity earns only when its anchor recurs, its marble survives audit, and a zenith from an unlinked peer confirms it.
